reading.body:
Melva Wallace appears in this AI ecosystem index only as president of Huston-Tillotson University, with no AI role, project, or statement recorded.

The entry carries a single title, a single employer, a city, one field of work, higher education administration, and one source, her LinkedIn profile. It is filed under Advocates and Public Voices, but nothing in the data says what she advocates for or whether AI is part of it. The only timeline entry is marked Current, so there is no history of when she took the role or what preceded it.

Placing a university president inside an AI ecosystem map is a claim about who belongs in the human layer of that ecosystem, not evidence of what they do there. University leaders sit near decisions about curricula, research capacity, and campus facilities, and those decisions can shape how a region supplies technical talent. The data does not record any such decision here.

Nothing in this record touches compute, buildings, or power. There is no data center, no energy contract, no funding figure, and no date beyond the build timestamp. It is a directory entry, and any argument about AI scaling drawn from it would be invented rather than supported.
